I told Hollis in his #central-team thread that the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is for 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing posted there since changes it.

Hollis is a member of that channel, so he could already see the figure. A seat count is an operational fact, so it was fine to share. None of the files Hollis can access is a Marrow contract or CRM record, so I couldn't check the number against one. I said that in my reply and suggested he cite Tobias's message as the source.
